vendor/game.js and vendor/assets.js are GENERATED. Do not edit them;
run node apps/q1k3/vendor.mjs.

upstream: https://github.com/phoboslab/q1k3
commit:   8ee934856c3f5de3c584724b9dd554314a911694
license:  MIT (COPYING-q1k3.txt); Sonant-X zlib (COPYING-sonant-x.txt)
music:    Andy Lösch, no-fate.net (sonant data in source/music.js)

game.js is the uncompressed classic-script sources concatenated in the
order index.html listed them, minus document.js (the GifOS shell owns
the page). fetch() of build/l and build/m is patched to read Q1K3_MAP
and Q1K3_MODELS from assets.js, because a GIF srcdoc cannot fetch.
assets.js is the packed maps and models the original build.sh produced
(pack_map.c + pack_model.php, the latter reimplemented in this file).
Both notices travel INSIDE the GIF as well as beside it here.
